# AI Solutions

> AI Solutions builds custom business automation systems and AI agents on n8n — including dashboards and web apps — to turn manual operations into systems that run on their own.

AI Solutions is a business-automation studio specializing in n8n workflows, AI agents, operational dashboards, and web/app development. We serve SMBs and operations teams across multiple sectors and countries, delivering tailored automations rather than off-the-shelf tools. The site is available in Arabic (default) and English.

## Core pages
- [Home (Arabic)](/): Overview of services, proof, process, case studies, and contact.
- [Home (English)](/en): English version of the homepage.
- [About](/about): Founding story, differentiators, sectors served, and founder link (Arabic).
- [About (English)](/en/about): English version of the About page.

## Services
- [Services index (Arabic)](/services): All four service lines.
- [Services index (English)](/en/services): English version.
- [n8n Automation](/services/n8n-automation): Custom n8n workflow automation for operations, sales, and back-office processes.
- [AI Agents](/services/ai-agents): Custom AI agents for support, lead qualification, and internal ops.
- [Dashboards](/services/dashboards): Operational dashboards that consolidate data from tools and workflows.
- [Web Development](/services/web-development): Marketing sites and lightweight web apps tied to automations.
- [n8n Automation (EN)](/en/services/n8n-automation)
